successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: Old Calabar, whose chiefs 'placed themselves under British protection in 1884'; headquarters of the Niger Coast Protectorate 1884-1906

ledger.x: c. 1650: Duke Town is founded. 'Dukes Town is believed to have been founded in about 1650 according to historians Ekei Essien Oku and Efiong U. Aye'; the Efik 'had become a power on the coast of the Bight of Biafra by the early 18th century'.
1884: the Calabar chiefs accept British protection.
1884: the independent Efik city-states end; the Obong of Calabar title replaced King in 1903.
